root_cause: The existing deterministic parallel planner had no hard wave-size bound and did not classify mismatched base epochs, identical candidate heads, or identical obligations as concurrent-writer conflicts.

evidence.previous_behavior: Every ready non-conflicting work package could join a single unbounded Promise.all wave; base epoch and writer identity were not compared.
evidence.baseline_main_sha: read from protected GitHub main at commit creation
evidence.admission_recovery: GitHub Required admission first rejected missing evaluation.historical_replay. Existing test is now explicitly registered without weakening the gate.

prevention: Maximum four concurrent packages in policy, with hard cap six in code
One writer per obligation and candidate SHA
No speculative integration across main epochs
Executor independently rejects manually forged waves
Protected Required, CodeQL, merge and exact-main production readback remain mandatory
Canonical learning evaluation.historical_replay must point to runnable tests/brain-*.test.mjs before protected admission
